rules: After restart, durable requests (durable lane: URSM-mediated, leased) MUST be recovered by the new gateway instance.
Lease-based takeover is mandatory; without the lease, the new instance MUST NOT act on the durable row.
Fencing token is required and verified before any upstream retry.
If the prior lease expired before restart, the new gateway MUST re-issue exactly one upstream call (lease_expired_upstream_calls=1) to confirm terminal state.
If the prior lease was still live at restart time, no new upstream call is made (lease_live_upstream_calls=0).
validation_rules: durable lane MUST enforce lease on takeover
durable lane MUST issue exactly 1 upstream call when lease was expired at restart
durable lane MUST issue 0 upstream calls when lease was live at restart
